name: spark-inspect
description: Deterministically fetch and decode Lucko Spark profiler reports into structured JSON. Completed reports are edge-cacheable; live profiler payloads are marked live and never cached. This tool reports data only; it does not diagnose or recommend.

input.thread: required for tree; optional for plugin-tree
input.source: required for plugin-tree; plugin/source name from pluginPerformance

operations.overview: Report metadata, statistics, sampler roots, hotspots, and windows
operations.metadata: Report metadata, platform, plugins, and configuration
operations.plugins: Plugin/mod metadata, server configuration, and sampler-attributed performance records
operations.statistics: Platform, system, metrics, and profiler window statistics
operations.threads: Sampler thread roots and sample-window counts
operations.hotspots: Flattened sampler nodes ordered by sampled time
operations.search: Sampler nodes whose method name contains q
operations.tree: Resolved sampler call tree for a named thread
operations.plugin-tree: Resolved call branches containing a mapped plugin/source
operations.live: Whether the payload includes Spark live-profiler channel information
